art_direction.materials: Reuse the shipped Poly Haven CC0 panel, metal, rock and dirt scans; physical UV scale, packed normal/roughness, vertical runoff and settled dust. No new external image download.
art_direction.silhouette: Rounded pressure modules and service doors; layered greenhouse balconies; parabolic antenna back frames and feed hardware.
art_direction.terrain_contact: Shallow irregular flagstones, conforming drainage grates, feathered sediment and buried mineral layers. Damp habitat tint and cold summit deposits blend into the continuous existing surface.
art_direction.foliage: Bent stems and small ovate blades at roof planters and foundation margins, rather than rock-shaped green clumps.

changes: All generic facility entrances use rounded, braced docking frames and shielded fixtures.
Habitat support buildings use stepped two-storey shells, service terraces and pipework.
All regional service rooms use rounded shells, recessed glazing, seals, vents and bolted hardware.
Habitat landmark receives two windowed elevations, curved balcony rails, planted edges and external service details.
Relay receives panelled foundation, capped utility runs, drains and mechanical dish details.
Observatory receives curved panel seams, bearing and dish back frames, windows, grilles, roof access rails and pipework.
Loose rock silhouettes use buried mineral facets; habitat and summit ground palettes are localized to their actual landmark positions.

contracts.terrain_heights: unchanged; render-only surface dressing is <=5 world units above ground
